svg.title: 2 Foundation: footings, necks and the lift pit
svg.text: 2 Foundation: footings, necks and the lift pit
Footing outlines from S1 (sheet FP), neck outlines from FP, ground-beam edges from GBP; the sheets share one frame layout, so their local mm align.
4 walls, indicative only (pit depth not printed)
drawn edges from sheet GBP; span-by-span states are in F06b (the registers hold the edge lines, not the span ends)
